predictions.title: MWE-200: Insecure LP Token Value Calculation
predictions.description: Liquidity token value/price can be manipulated to cause flashloan attacks.
predictions.impact: Manipulating LP token valuation inputs may misprice liquidity positions and distort financial operation amounts, potentially causing incorrect payouts or loss of funds. Actual exploitability requires further verification.
predictions.mitigation: Do not use AMM pool or custom liquidity calculation to caculate LP token value/price.
predictions.report_basis: rule-template; not an LLM-generated exploit proof

predictions.title: MWE-209: Wrong Order for Interest or ExchangeRate
predictions.description: Update of interest or exchange rate should be executed before calculating new balance, share, stake, loan or fee.
predictions.impact: Financial operations performed before interest or exchange-rate updates may use stale accounting values, causing incorrect balances, shares, debt, fees or rewards and potentially allowing value extraction or loss of funds. Actual exploitability requires further verification.
predictions.mitigation: Check the business logic and move the statements about updating exchange rate or interest forward.
